svg.title: Four types of discontinuity
svg.desc: The panels compare a common missing height, unequal one-sided heights, unbounded behavior, and endless oscillation. A two-by-two gallery compares behavior at x = 0. Removable shows y = x + 1 with an open point at (0, 1). Jump shows y = 0 to the left and y = 2 to the right with open and filled markers. Infinite shows y = 1/x on split domains with a vertical asymptote. Oscillatory shows y = sin(1/x) on split domains that never settle near zero. Panel titles name each type. Open and filled markers distinguish inclusion, the jump branches use different line styles, and the infinite panel has a dashed asymptote. Caption: The four principal discontinuity types encountered in first-semester calculus. Reading order: removable-panel: Both sides approach one missing height.; removable-left: Solid left branch stops before zero.; removable-right: Solid right branch begins after zero.; removable-hole: Open circle marks the removable hole.; jump-panel: Finite one-sided limits disagree.; jump-left: Solid lower branch approaches zero.; jump-right: Double-stroked upper branch starts at height two.; jump-open: Open circle marks the left-hand height zero.; jump-closed: Filled diamond marks the included right-hand height two.; infinite-panel: Outputs become unbounded at a vertical asymptote.; infinite-left: Solid reciprocal branch stops before zero.; infinite-right: Solid reciprocal branch begins after zero.; infinite-asymptote: Dashed vertical asymptote at zero.; oscillatory-panel: Outputs continue oscillating without settling.; oscillatory-left: Solid oscillating branch stops before zero.; oscillatory-right: Solid oscillating branch begins after zero..

g.title: Removable
g.desc: Both sides approach one missing height.

g.aria-label: Open circle marks the removable hole.
Solid left branch stops before zero.
Solid right branch begins after zero.
Filled diamond marks the included right-hand height two.
Open circle marks the left-hand height zero.
Double-stroked upper branch starts at height two.

g.title: Infinite
g.desc: Outputs become unbounded at a vertical asymptote.

g.aria-label: Solid reciprocal branch stops before zero.
Solid reciprocal branch begins after zero.
Solid oscillating branch stops before zero.
Solid oscillating branch begins after zero.
